faqs.q: What makes Capital Operator different from loan broker CRM software?
faqs.a: Capital Operator is not a generic contact database; it is an operational diagnostic and architectural blueprint engine. It audits where your pipeline leaks time and capital, then provides an exact mathematical implementation plan.

faqs.q: Do I need to sign up or input credit cards to receive my blueprint?
faqs.a: No. Capital Operator is completely free and executes 100% in your browser without requiring account creation or payment information.

faqs.q: Can I integrate Capital Operator recommendations with my existing CRM?
faqs.a: Yes. Our recommendations are tool-agnostic. Whether you run HubSpot, Salesforce, Airtable, or Notion, our blueprints provide schema mappings and workflow trigger logic.

faqs.q: How does Moonshine Capital support operators after the diagnostic?
faqs.a: Through our syndicate network and ecosystem tools, Moonshine Capital offers secondary desk support, direct underwriting facilities, and technology integrations to accelerate placement yield.
